items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, I played brass bands with him.

ctx.x: Now did you ever play with him in any brass bands? Yeah.
Yeah, I played brass bands with him.
Was he mostly high note bands on people of Tony?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I played with the Pacific band with Rene, with Rene was the lead, and I don't know, he quit or something. I led that band with Talbot.

ctx.x: it was their band. What's Wilson's first name? I didn't

get it. Oh, I know his brother was named Johnny Wilson. I just remember what his name was. His brother was Johnny Wilson, and old man Bob was playing in that band at that time. Ray, the bass player, he was playing trombone at that time. Big Connie, they were playing. I played that band, and I played with the Pacific band with Rene, with Rene was the lead, and I don't know, he quit or something. I led that band with Talbot. He was playing trumpet. And Edgar Mosley, he was playing the bass drum. I can't recall…
a brass band at that time. Did they have a clarinet player?
